title: OfflinePassIssuanceResponse
description: HTTP response body of the server's pass issuance endpoint (POST /api/v1/offline/passes) per spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3. Returns the signed OfflinePass and the trust bundle the app holds while it has no network. The app replaces the bundle it holds with this one on every issuance (app-contract.md 3.4).

stationCaCrl.description: The Station CA's current certificate revocation list (spec/06-security.md 2.1.1), PEM.

serverKeys.description: The server key set (spec/06-security.md 6.7): every key a pass may currently be signed under, including a key published ahead of its first signature and a retired key kept until its last pass has expired.

keyId.description: Base64url (unpadded) of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of publicKey (spec/06-security.md 4.3). An OfflinePass names its signing key by this value.

publicKey.description: The key's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (id-ecPublicKey, prime256v1, point uncompressed), Base64: 124 characters, the body of the key's PEM without its armour.
